summary: Connects to WebSocket servers, receives and parses text or binary WebSocket messages, appends them to a FIFO DAT table, and can execute callbacks for each message.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable receiving from the WebSocket connection

key_params.name: netaddress
key_params.note: Server host, IP, localhost, or wss:// address

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Callback DAT executed for each message

key_params.name: fromop
key_params.note: Execution origin when Execute from is Specified Operator

key_params.name: bytes
key_params.note: Output raw bytes in a separate column

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when extension mode uses a custom extension

common_gotchas: This DAT is a WebSocket client; use Web Server DAT when TouchDesigner needs to host WebSocket clients.
Secure servers generally use port 443; non-443 secure connections need a wss:// prefix in Network Address.
Messages are appended to a FIFO table, so set Clamp Output and Maximum Lines for long-running connections.
Status and errors are printed to TouchDesigner's text console, which may need TOUCH_TEXT_CONSOLE=1 to inspect.
Use SocketIO DAT for Socket.IO protocol support rather than raw WebSocket DAT.
key_concepts: WebSocket DAT is a WebSocket client that receives text and binary frames into a FIFO DAT table.
Callbacks handle connect, disconnect, text, binary, ping, pong, and monitor-message events.
Secure non-443 connections require a wss:// network address prefix.
Clamp and maximum line controls should be set for long-running message streams.
